responsibility: Declares the common HIRCompileBase support class used by most Rust backend lowering visitors. It defines the shared interface for coercions, autoderef and unsizing adjustments, trait item address computation, array-size verification, path query compilation, function and constant construction, attribute handling, ABI setup, block-local discovery, and basic address/indirection helpers, serving as the cross-cutting utility API for HIR-to-GCC tree generation.
same_name_distinction: Defines the reusable HIRCompileBase helper interface that other lowering visitors inherit from, collecting declarations for coercion, adjustment, function/constant construction, ABI, and attribute utilities. Unlike the .cc file, it does not perform lowering itself; it is the shared base-class contract for those implementations.
